name: Liberty Citations: Install, Status, Corpus Build, Refresh and Add Sources
description: Operates the liberty-citations toolkit: checks what works with liberty_status, installs it in Claude Code (install.sh: venv, ffmpeg, deno, yt-dlp, faster-whisper, MCP registration), runs the first corpus build (library_setup as a background job, about 10 minutes), keeps the corpus fresh (stoky_sync, misescz_sync, youtube_catalog refresh, ankap sync, fetch and index after manifest changes), adds an article or the user's own copy of a paid book with add_source (never from a shadow library), and fixes the usual failures (YouTube bot checks, mises.org 403, CUDA libraries, Groq 429, database is locked). Variables: task - status, install, first build, a refresh, add source, or an error to fix; environment - OS and hardware; details - URL or path, author, title, year and language, or the error text.
content:
# Liberty Citations: toolkit operations

Install, check, build, refresh and extend the liberty-citations toolkit.

## Task
- Task: {{task}}
- Environment: {{environment}}
- Details: {{details}}

## 1. Look before you act
Call `liberty_status` (CLI `liberty doctor`, then `liberty status`). Read the modules and binaries present (ffmpeg, ffprobe, deno, pdftotext; requests, bs4, pymupdf, pypdf, yt_dlp, faster_whisper, mcp), CUDA, which speech-to-text keys are set, the auto engine order, the corpus count per source, the library state and the recent jobs. An unknown tool means the toolkit is not installed here: in claude.ai say so and continue on the web path (`liberty-tools-reference`); in Claude Code go to step 2.

## 2. Install (Claude Code)
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cd ~/.claude/skills
unzip ~/Downloads/liberty-citations.zip          # creates ./liberty-citations/
bash liberty-citations/scripts/install.sh        # venv, ffmpeg, deno, yt-dlp, faster-whisper, MCP
liberty setup                                    # first corpus build, about 10 minutes
```
Restart Claude Code so the `mcp__liberty__*` tools appear. System packages: Arch or Omarchy `sudo pacman -S ffmpeg deno`; Kubuntu `sudo apt install ffmpeg python3-venv` and deno from deno.land. GPU: the nvidia driver plus the pip CUDA wheels install.sh adds (or `pacman -S cuda cudnn`). Ask before a command that needs sudo.

## 3. First corpus build
`library_setup()` starts a job of about 10 minutes: it downloads the free library listed in `manifest.json`, indexes it, crawls ankap.urza.cz and Stoky and fetches the video catalogue. Poll `job_status(job_id)`, and work on the web path meanwhile. When it is done, call `liberty_status` again and report the counts per source.

## 4. Keep it fresh
| Need | Tool (job) | CLI |
|---|---|---|
| new Stoky posts | `stoky_sync()`; `full=true` only after the site changed | `liberty stoky sync` |
| new videos | `youtube_catalog(refresh=true)` | `liberty yt catalog --refresh` |
| more mises.cz articles | `misescz_sync(limit=300)`, which resumes where the last crawl stopped | `liberty misescz sync --limit 300` |
| Urza's texts | none | `liberty ankap sync` |
| books added to the manifest | none | `liberty fetch && liberty index` |
One writer at a time: a crawl and an index together give `database is locked` (searching still works).

## 5. Add a source
- An article: `add_source(target="<url>", author="…", title="…", year="…", lang="cs")` (or `lang="en"`).
- The user's own copy of a book that is not free (*The Ethics of Liberty*, *Economics in One Lesson*, Urza's *Anarchokapitalismus*, Szasz, Hoppe's *Democracy*): `add_source(target="/path/to/book.pdf", …)`. A scanned PDF needs OCR first: `ocrmypdf in.pdf out.pdf`. Never fetch such a book from a shadow library: point to buying it (kniha.urza.cz for Urza's book) or to a library.
- Then `search_quotes` with a phrase from the new source to confirm it is indexed with locators.

## 6. Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| YouTube "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" | set `LIBERTY_YTDLP_COOKIES_BROWSER=firefox` (or chrome, brave), update yt-dlp in the venv (`pip install -U yt-dlp`), check deno is installed |
| mises.org answers 403 | it limits bursts; the manifest uses `cdn.mises.org` files. If a link moved, open the book's `page` from the manifest, put the new link in `manifest.json`, then `liberty fetch <id> && liberty index <id>` |
| faster-whisper cuDNN or cuBLAS errors | run through the `liberty` wrappers (they set `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`), or `pacman -S cuda cudnn` |
| Groq 429 | free-tier limits; the toolkit waits on `retry-after`. Long batches go overnight or on a GPU |
| `database is locked` | two writers at once; let one finish |
| empty corpus after setup | read the log tail with `job_status`; rerun only the failed step (`liberty fetch`, `liberty index`, `liberty stoky sync`) |

## 7. Report
What you checked, what you ran, the corpus counts per source before and after, jobs still running with their ids, and what the user has to do (a key, a login, a sudo step). Never print a key's value.
